adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23 that the limit parameter is taken directly from user input with only a default fallback: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`. There is no upper bound validation, so a caller could pass an arbitrarily large limit value (e.g., limit=1000000) which would force the database to return and serialize a potentially massive number of records. This is a real security/performance vulnerability - a denial of service vector through resource exhaustion.
